summary: The United States military announced a new wave of strikes against Iran, with explosions reported deep inside the country including Shiraz, Bushehr, Bandar Abbas, and Tehran-area locations. Israeli forces killed two Hamas Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza Strip. Iran's Revolutionary Guards stated they downed an MQ-9 drone over Andimeshk using an air-defense system.
key_points: The US military announced the opening of an additional wave of attacks against Iran with explosions reported in Shiraz and deep inside the country (Source: @New_security8200/202628).
Two strikes were reported in Bushehr at 0247 local time and 2317Z according to field reports from the area (Source: @shin_persian/7951).
The Revolutionary Guards public relations stated an MQ-9 hostile drone was spotted and downed over Andimeshk by an air-defense system of the aerospace force (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/377799).
Israeli forces killed two Hamas Nukhba Force commanders in northern Gaza Strip in a precise aerial strike last night (Source: @manniefabian/58790).
Iran launched ballistic missiles from western Iran, Azerbaijan Province, and Lorestan Province according to field monitoring (Source: @shin_persian/7954).
US Central Command stated it disabled an empty tanker headed toward an Iranian port in the Persian Gulf after it ignored warnings (Source: @SharghDaily/172256).
Iran's Health Ministry stated 35 compatriots were martyred in July attacks by noon today, with Hormozgan, Sistan-Baluchestan and Khuzestan most affected (Source: @SharghDaily/172255).
Lebanese media reported an Israeli strike between Kounine and Beit Yahoun in southern Lebanon inside Israel's buffer zone (Source: @manniefabian/58792).

sections.executive_summary: The United States military announced a new wave of strikes against Iran with explosions reported deep inside the country including Shiraz, Bushehr, Bandar Abbas, and Tehran-area locations. Israeli forces killed two Hamas Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza Strip in a precise aerial strike. Iran's Revolutionary Guards downed an MQ-9 drone over Andimeshk and launched ballistic missiles from western Iran, Azerbaijan, and Lorestan provinces.

points: The Revolutionary Guards public relations stated that minutes ago an MQ-9 hostile drone was detected over Andimeshk city and downed by a modern air-defense system belonging to the IRGC aerospace force (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/377799).
Two strikes were reported in Bushehr at 0247 local time and 2317Z according to field monitoring in Bushehr Province, Iran (Source: @shin_persian/7951).

Residents reported multiple explosions in Bandar Abbas from 01:26 onward including at the air base east of the city, with air-defense activation and heavy blasts at 02:20 and 02:26 (Source: @VahidOnline/77133).

Air-defense activity and explosions were reported in Pakdasht, Parchin, and Varamin near Tehran from 03:18 to 03:46, with the governor stating the sounds were from air-defense system activity (Source: @VahidOnline/77136).
Iran's Health Ministry stated 35 compatriots were martyred in July attacks by noon today, with Hormozgan, Sistan-Baluchestan and Khuzestan most affected (Source: @SharghDaily/172255).
Ballistic missiles were launched from western Iran, Azerbaijan Province, and Lorestan Province according to field monitoring (Source: @shin_persian/7954).

IDF representatives reported to cabinet ministers that Israel holds 67-70% of Gaza Strip territory, per publication approved by censor (Source: @inon_yttach/9483).

The Chief of Staff at an intelligence community memorial ceremony stated intelligence personnel are monitoring developments in Iran and other arenas, ready to act forcefully (Source: @New_security8200/202634).
A drone from Iran hit a target in Kuwait and Jordan's army intercepted three missiles launched from Iran per overnight documentation (Source: @inon_yttach/9474).

sections.threat_assessment: The United States has opened a new wave of strikes against Iran with reported explosions in Shiraz, Bushehr, Bandar Abbas, and Tehran-area locations including Parchin and Pakdasht. Iran has responded with ballistic missile launches from western Iran, Azerbaijan, and Lorestan provinces, and drone strikes on Kuwait and US positions in Iraq. Israeli forces maintain 67-70% control of Gaza and continue targeted killings of Hamas Nukhba commanders. The escalation indicates direct US-Iran confrontation with regional spillover via Iranian proxies in Iraq, Kuwait, Jordan, and Lebanon.
sections.regional_response: Jordan's army intercepted three missiles launched from Iran and explosions were heard in Jordan after Iran strikes. Kuwait was struck by an Iranian drone and also reported as a launch point for attacks toward Iran. Iran summoned the British ambassador over the UK's IRGC designation warning of firm reciprocal response. The US renewed naval blockade on Iran has diverted two vessels attempting to break it, expanding maritime pressure in the Persian Gulf.
sections.intelligence_notes: Field reports from VahidOnline detail sustained air-defense activity and explosions in Bandar Abbas from 01:26 with hits near the air base, and in Pakdasht-Parchin from 03:18 to 03:46 with governor confirming air-defense activation. Israeli security channels cite IDF holding 67-70% of Gaza and eliminating Nukhba commanders via precise aerial strike. Iranian state media reports 35 martyred in July attacks with Hormozgan, Sistan-Baluchestan, Khuzestan most affected. Open-source signals show multi-front Iranian missile and drone employment against US and allied targets.
